_comment: Curated short display names for teams whose official football-data names carry numbers that read badly on match cards and in notifications. Key = football-data team id (as a string), value = { name: official name (for reference only), display: what to show }. The single source of truth for BOTH the app (match cards, standings, team lists, favourites, the assistant) and push-notification text (scripts/push_events.py). Additive: the official name stays in all data and is still used for search and matching. Only list teams deliberately - never derive by stripping digits (FC Schalke 04 is intentionally absent). Teams not listed show their official name.
